Class LogConfig

java.lang.Object
chess.util.LogConfig
public final class LogConfig extends Object
Sets up java.util.logging for the application.

Every class logs through a logger named after itself (for example chess.service.Game). Those loggers are children of the "chess" logger, so configuring that one logger here controls all of them. init() sends their output to logs/chess.log instead of the console, so log lines never mix with the console game's board.

    • ROOT

      private static final Logger ROOT
      The parent logger of every application logger. Kept in a static field because Logger.getLogger holds loggers only weakly; without this reference the configured logger could be garbage-collected and its settings lost.

  • Method Details

    • init

      public static void init()
      Sends application log messages (level FINE and above) to logs/chess.log, appending to any existing file. Safe to call more than once.

    • init

      public static void init(Path directory)
      Sends application log messages (level FINE and above) to chess.log in the given directory. If the file cannot be opened, logging falls back to the console and a warning is printed; the game still runs.
      Parameters:
      directory - where to write the log file

    • silence

      public static void silence()
      Turns application logging off entirely, for runs whose console output must stay clean (the scenario driver). Has no effect after init(Path) has run.
